UCO Bank Specialist Officer SO Bharti 2026 : Educational Qualification

Post Name  Qualification
Manager-AI/ML Engineer
  • Candidates must have a full-time B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI & ML, or Data Science with a minimum of 50% marks, or an MCA/M.Tech./M.E. in the relevant fields with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized institution. Certification in AI, Generative AI, NLP, or ML is preferred. Candidates must have at least 3 years of post-qualification experience in the development and implementation of AI, Gen AI, NLP, or Content Analysis-based projects, along with proficiency in R/Python, Neural Networks, NLP, and Big Data technologies such as Kafka and Spark.
Manager-Cyber Security
  • Candidates must have a full-time B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Computer Science & Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, Electronics & Communications Engineering, or an equivalent degree with a minimum of 50% marks, or MCA/M.Tech./M.Sc. in the relevant fields with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized institution. An advanced degree in Cyber Security or IT is preferred. Candidates must have at least 3 years of post-qualification hands-on experience in offensive cyber security, including Red Team operations, AI Red Team operations, penetration testing, cyber security testing, vulnerability assessment, exploitation, or adversary emulation. Candidates should have knowledge of cyber-attack TTPs, penetration testing tools such as Metasploit, Cobalt Strike and Burp Suite, exploit development, reverse engineering, adversarial AI, MITRE ATT&CK, and scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell and Bash.
